name: Brookhollow Marketplace
summary: Brookhollow Marketplace is a community shopping center in northwest Houston serving a high daytime population from nearby businesses and residential areas. The open-air center offers convenient access to retail, dining, and services along the I-10 corridor.
demographics: Brookhollow Marketplace serves a diverse daytime population drawn from nearby businesses and residential communities in northwest Houston. The trade area attracts middle-income professionals and families seeking convenient shopping options near major employment centers along the I-10 corridor. Primary visitors include working adults aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $45,000 to $85,000, who value accessibility and practical retail options for everyday needs. The center benefits from strong weekday traffic from office workers and consistent weekend visits from surrounding neighborhoods.
description: Brookhollow Marketplace is a well-established community shopping center located at 4500 Dacoma Street in northwest Houston, Texas. Strategically positioned to serve the bustling Brookhollow business district and surrounding residential areas, this open-air retail destination has become a convenient hub for both daytime professionals and local families. The center benefits from its proximity to major transportation corridors and a high daytime population generated by nearby office complexes and commercial developments. Managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRPLTD), Brookhollow Marketplace offers a practical mix of retail, dining, and service tenants that cater to the everyday needs of the community. With ample parking and easy accessibility, the center maintains a strong presence in Houston's competitive northwest retail market, providing shoppers with a straightforward and efficient shopping experience.
